FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part IV ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 25 September 1980, after the draft finalized by the Recording Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. 0.2 This standard covers the performance requirements for disk record playing units intended for high fidelity reproducing systems for home use. 0.2.1 The characteristics amplitude non-linearity and non-linear distortion have been kept under consideration till complete information is available as to their methods of measurement and performance requirements. 0.3 Other standards of this series consist of the following parts: : General Part I Part II : Amplifier Part III : Loudspeaker Part V : Magnetic sound tape recording and reproducing equipment. 0.4 While preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from the following: IEC Publication 581-3 - High fideIity audio equipment and systems. Minimum performance requirements : Part 3 Record playing cartridges. International Electrotechnical equipment and Commission. Minimum DIN : 45500 ( Blatt 3 ) - High fidelity techniques. requirements for record playing equipment. Deutscher Normenausschuss. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value 1960". should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. *Rules for rounding off numerica!
values ( revised).

SCOPE 1.1 This standard ( Part IV ) specifies the performance requirements for disk record playing units, comprising the drive system for the record and the reproducing pick-up system, and intended for high fidelity reproducing systems for home use. 2. TERMINOLOGY 2.1 For the purpose of this standard, the terms and definitions covered in IS : 1885 ( Part XLVIII/Sec 2 )-1978*, IS : 97291_ and IS : 9272 ( Part I )1979$ shall apply. 3. GENERAL CONDITIONS FOR MEASUREMENT 3.1 Provision of 3 of IS : 9729f shall apply. 4. DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION 4.1 Provision of 3 of IS : 9272 ( Part I )-1979$ and 3 of IS : 9272 ( Part II): 19795 shall apply. 5. DISK RECORDS 5.1 The unit shall be capable of handling all disk records conforming to IS : 9305-197911. AND OTHER COMPONENT PARTS 6.1 Provision of 5 of IS : 9272 ( Part I j-1979$ and 4 of IS : 9272 (Part II ) 19793 shall apply. 7. POWER 8. SAFETY 8.1 The equipment shall conform to the requirements 616-19577 so far as mains operation is concerned. 9. COLOUR CODING shall apply. 9.1 Provisions of 9 of IS : 9272 ( Part I )-1979$ 10. 11.1 This manual shall contain operating, maintenance and any other special instructions required for long operating life of the equipment. 13.3 Environmental Tests 13.3.1 Climatic Sequence Test 13.3.1.1 Dry heat - This test shall be carried out at a temperature of 40�C and duration of 96 hours in accordance with IS : 9000 ( Part III/ Set 5 )-1977*. 13.3.1.2 Damp heat (jrst cycle ) - The first cycle shall be carried out in accordance with IS : 2106 ( Part II )-1962t. 13.3.1.3 Cold- This test shall be carried out at a temperature of -10�C and duration of 16 hours in accordance with IS : 9000 ( Part II )1977$. 13.3.1.4 Damp heat ( second cycle ) - The second carried out in accordance with IS : 2106 ( Part II )-19627 period of 24 hours. cycle shall be after a recovery

13.3.2 Bump Test-This test shall be carried out in accordance with IS : 9000 ( Part VII/Set 2 )-19793 with 4 000 bumps with an acceleration of 400 f 40 m/sec2. 13.3.3 Drop Test - This test shall be conducted in accordance with 9.2 of IS : 9000 ( Part VII/Set 3 )-197811. The height of drop being 25 mm. 13.3.4 Vibration Test - This test shall be conducted in accordance IS : 2106 ( Part XVI )-19717. Frequency range = lo-150 Hz = 0.15 mm or 2,6 Amplitude = 6 hours. APPENDIX A ( Clause 13.1.2)
SAMPLING A-l. LOT AND CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY

A-l.1 All the disk record playing equipments of the same model and type having the same design and manufactured by the same technique under eventually similar conditions of production shall constitute a lot. A-1.1.1 Samples shall be taken and tested to ascertain the conformity of each lot for acceptance tests. A-2. SCALE OF SAMPLING

A-2.1 Disk record playing equipment shall be taken at random according to Table 2 ( see IS : 4905-l%%* ).

A-3.1 Disk record playing equipments shall be drawn from each lot according to co1 1 and 2 of Table 2 and subjected to the acceptance tests If an equipment fails in any one of the acceptance specified in 13.1.2. If the number of defectives found in tests, it shall be called as defective, the first sample ( see co1 3 ) is zero ( see co1 5 ), the lot shall be considered as conforming to the acceptance tests. If the number of defectives is as equal to or greater than two ( see co1 6 ), the Jot shall be considered as not conforming to the acceptance tests. A-3.1.1 If the number of defectives is equal to one, further sample of equipment shall be taken as specified in co1 3 of Table 2 and tested for all the acceptance tests. If the number of defectives in the combined sample ( see co1 4 ), is less than two (see co1 6 ), the lot shall be considered as conforming to the acceptance tests otherwise rejected.
